project.name: Smart Real-Time Monitoring & Inspection App
project.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (MoSJE)

executive_summary: An enterprise-grade, offline-first mobile and cloud ecosystem for real-time tracking, geo-fenced inspection, algorithmic milestone weighting, budget dispute resolution, and citizen transparency across MoSJE infrastructure works.

backend.stack: PHP 8.3 / SQLite PDO / Custom REST Router
backend.auth: Stateless HMAC-SHA256 JWT with role-based jurisdiction checks
backend.database: 37 normalized relational tables with foreign keys and cascade rules
backend.security: 100% prepared statements (SQLi immune), strict input validation, sanitized error outputs, CORS middleware

mobile_app.camera: CameraX strictly isolated to in-app capture (zero gallery picker permissions)
mobile_app.watermark: Pixel-level burned-in watermark: 'for the people to the people' (40% opacity, bottom-right) + ISO timestamp + GPS coordinates (bottom-left)
mobile_app.gps_validation: Hardware location lock; uploads strictly blocked if horizontal accuracy > 100m
mobile_app.offline_sync: Room SQLite offline queue with WorkManager exponential backoff background synchronization

state_machine.mandatory_reinspection_rule: An inspection with an unresolved issue CANNOT be closed without a scheduled re-inspection that achieves a PASSED outcome.

escalation_fee_and_refund.uphold_behavior: If higher authority upholds the grievance, ₹472 is 100% automatically refunded to source account
escalation_fee_and_refund.reject_behavior: If higher authority rejects the grievance, the ₹472 deposit is permanently retained as an anti-spam penalty

citizen_nudge_rule.daily_quota: Strictly 1 nudge per citizen per calendar day across the entire app
citizen_nudge_rule.chance_burning: If reason is empty or under 10 characters, the day's chance is immediately burned and delivers nothing to the NGO

data_privacy.contractor_masking: Phone, email, and residential address of contractors are permanently masked for public users; visible only to authenticated officials and assigned NGOs

api_routes_summary.desc: List tenders with masked/unmasked contractor data based on role
Submit field inspection with GPS and watermark verification
State machine transition with mandatory reinspection gate
Decide grievance with automatic ₹472 refund on uphold
Submit citizen nudge with 1-per-day chance-burning rule
Download inspection report as formatted PDF
Export all tenders as CSV spreadsheet
